25-Year-Old Woman Fatally Shot Outside Olympic Gardens Home

By Mckoy's News / September 28, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

A 25-year-old woman was shot and killed outside her home in Olympic Gardens, St Andrew, on Sunday evening.

She has been identified as Ornellia Walker, otherwise called “Nana” or “Chin”, of Hibiscus Avenue.

According to police reports, Walker was sitting at her gate about 7:20 pm when she was approached by unknown assailants who opened fire, hitting her multiple times.

Police subsequently assisted the injured woman to hospital, where she was pronounced dead.

The motive for the killing has not been disclosed, and the circumstances surrounding the attack remain under investigation.
